QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] Undercover
QuestInfo.1: Talk to Bernhardt, the strange man wandering near the inn.
QuestInfo.2: You met a strange fellow named Bernhardt near the inn.

0.0: Now I can cook some tasty dishes made of car-rots and chik-ken! \r\n#L0##bWait a minute. You know who the princess is?#l\n#k
0.1: Yes, and I know you're looking for her. But we need to keep our dear princess safe. What kind of chef would I be if I betrayed her?\r\n#L0##bCan't you at least give me a hint?#l\n#k
0.2: You're good people. I can tell. I won't spill the princess's identity, but I can point you in the direction of someone who can.

yes.0: Look for a creepy guy named #bBernhardt#k. Talk to him and you'll be a step closer to meeting the princess.

no.0: Suit yourself! I've got a whole cookbook of recipes to explore. Next I'm trying chik-ken eyes scream!

yes.0: Halt! Who goes there? I mean, don't mind me, I'm just a nobody!

npc.0: #bBernhardt#k is creeping around with a hood over his head. Talk to him and you'll be a step closer to meeting the princess.
